characters.name: KARU KATI
characters.description: Väike pruun karu, pehmete karvadega, seljas sinine triibuline pluus ja kollased lühikesed püksid. Suured sõbralikud silmad ja naeratav nägu. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: ORAV OTT
characters.description: Väike hall orav, koheva sabaga, seljas roheline särk ja lühikesed punased püksid. Särab rõõmust ja on alati tegutsemas. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Rand
locations.description: Sunny sandy beach with gentle blue ocean waves in the background. A few colorful beach toys (a red bucket, a yellow shovel, a small blue flag on a stick) are on the sand. Bright sun is shining from above. Clear blue sky with a few fluffy white clouds. Cartoon style.

pages.text: KARU KATI JA ORAV OTT ON RANNAS.
pages.scene: Karu Kati, wearing a blue striped top and yellow shorts, and Orav Ott, wearing a green shirt and red shorts, are standing on a sunny sandy beach. They are looking at the blue ocean waves in the distance. A red bucket and a yellow shovel are lying on the sand near their feet. Both characters have friendly, happy expressions. The sky is clear blue with fluffy white clouds.

Karu Kati and Orav Ott are standing on the sunny sandy beach, now facing each other and smiling brightly. Orav Ott has his paws up in an excited gesture, while Karu Kati nods thoughtfully. They look like they've just had a great idea. The red bucket and yellow shovel are still on the sand near them.

Karu Kati is kneeling on the sandy beach, using the yellow shovel to scoop sand into the red bucket. Orav Ott is standing next to her, watching eagerly and pointing at the sand. Both are smiling, focused on their task. The ocean is visible in the background.

Karu Kati is carefully holding the red bucket, which is now filled with sand and some water, tilting it slightly. Orav Ott is holding a small seashell and pouring a tiny stream of water from it into the bucket. They are working together on the sunny sandy beach, both with concentrated and happy expressions.

Karu Kati and Orav Ott are standing proudly beside a large, cone-shaped mound of wet sand on the sunny beach. The red bucket and yellow shovel are lying on the sand nearby. They are smiling at their creation, ready for the next step.

Karu Kati and Orav Ott are busy shaping the large sand mound into a sandcastle. Karu Kati is using her paws to pat down the sides, forming walls. Orav Ott is using the yellow shovel to smooth out a section of the wall. A red bucket is nearby. They are focused and happy, with the ocean in the background.

Karu Kati is carefully placing a small blue flag on top of the sandcastle, which now has distinct walls and turrets. Orav Ott is standing beside the sandcastle, looking up at the flag with an excited smile. The red bucket and yellow shovel are on the sand at the base of the sandcastle. The sun shines brightly on their creation.

Karu Kati and Orav Ott are standing side-by-side, admiring their finished sandcastle. The sandcastle is detailed with walls and a blue flag on top. They are smiling broadly and looking at the sandcastle with pride. The red bucket and yellow shovel are neatly placed beside the sandcastle. The sunny beach and ocean are in the background.

Karu Kati and Orav Ott are sitting happily on the sand beside their magnificent sandcastle. Karu Kati has her arm gently around Orav Ott, and both are laughing and looking at each other. Their completed sandcastle with the blue flag stands tall next to them. The sun is warm, and the ocean waves are calm in the background. They are clearly proud and delighted with their work.
